_meta.description: [Recruitment] 03 — CRM Routing: Receives scored candidate payload from Batch 3. Upserts HubSpot Contact with AI score custom properties (create or update by email). Extracts contact ID. Creates HubSpot Deal associated with the contact. Merges CRM IDs (hubspotContactId + hubspotDealId) into payload for Batch 5.
_meta.validationStatus: 1 false-positive (stage field uses loadOptionsMethod — valid stages can't be loaded offline; must configure per HubSpot account before activation). 3 advisory warnings covered by master error workflow.
_meta.qaStatus: ALL PASS — PM · Lead n8n Eng · Lead Eng · Design Eng · QA Eng · Best Practices (Batch 4)
_meta.codeNodeContext: n8n Code nodes use step-through require() pattern; runtime n8n sandbox features
placeholders: [HUBSPOT_CREDENTIAL_ID] — replace with your n8n hubspotAppToken credential ID (HubSpot Private App Token). See SETUP.md.
[HUBSPOT_DEAL_STAGE_ID] — replace with your HubSpot deal stage ID. Find at: HubSpot → Settings → CRM → Deals → Pipelines. Common defaults: appointmentscheduled, qualifiedtobuy, presentationscheduled.
hubspotCustomPropertiesRequired: ai_role_applied (Single-line text) — role the candidate applied for
ai_scored_at (Date/time) — ISO timestamp when scoring ran
